specimen: The Birdhouse — thebirdhouse.co (agency site), thebirdhouse.email (newsletter + gated X Playbook)
method: Headless Chrome over CDP: rendered DOM, computed styles, bounding boxes, document.fonts, CSSOM keyframes (same-origin only), screenshots at 20 widths. Public pages only. No source maps, no authenticated areas. Raw data under ../styles, ../typography, ../geometry, ../motion, ../assets, ../dom, ../responsive.
notObserved: The playbook body itself sits behind an email gate on thebirdhouse.email/x-playbook; only the gate (h=1011px) was captured. The founder's description of the playbook UX (one concept per screen, oversized headings, physical analogies, card flips) is recorded in ../notes/README.md as reported, not as measured.
Testimonial video and carousel sections on thebirdhouse.co lazy-render (Wistia/Swiper); the full-page capture shows them blank. Their text was captured from the DOM; their motion was not.
IntersectionObserver-driven reveals: none detected in CSSOM (2 keyframes on the agency site, both marquee/loader); Webflow interactions run in JS and were not introspected.

textSecondary.note: navy at alpha, never a separate grey

colourRoles.separators: none — sections separated by illustrated grass/cloud edges and card boundaries rather than rules
colourRoles.inputs: white field, 2px navy outline on the newsletter capture, cyan submit

display.transform: none (site); uppercase display on the playbook gate

typography.maxLineLength: hero copy ~500px wide at 1440; card copy ~300px
typography.emphasis: italic serif for eyebrows ('Founders, CEOs, Business Owners:'); platform names replaced by icon chips inline in the headline

hero.composition: two columns: headline left (~40%), illustration cluster right; white card with 40px radius floating on the sky canvas; grass edge at the card's foot

sections.rhythm: each section is a floating white card or a stat cluster; vertical gaps ~90–120px

layout.grid: stat cards 2×2 around a central tree illustration; process list as stacked rows; FAQ accordion
layout.asymmetry: illustrations overlap card edges (birdhouses over the hero card's right edge; owl and toucan over stat cards)
layout.fullBleed: footer wordmark spans the full width at ~200px

shapeLanguage.borders: none on cards; 2px navy outline on form fields
shapeLanguage.imperfection: hand-drawn grass and cloud edges; no rotation on cards

illustrationGrammar.style: cartoon mascots (anthropomorphised birdhouses, birds, owl, toucan) with black outlines, flat pastel fills, light shading, big expressive eyes
illustrationGrammar.density: clusters of 8–12 characters in the hero; single characters beside each stat
illustrationGrammar.role: decorative in the hero and stats; instructional in the newsletter thumbnails where each post is a physical analogy (a claw machine, a hose over pots, folding chairs, a front door)
illustrationGrammar.placement: overlapping card edges, sitting on grass, holding props (phone, laptop, cash, coins)
illustrationGrammar.analogyUse: newsletter: one physical scene per idea, headline explains the scene

animationGrammar.reducedMotion: no prefers-reduced-motion rule detected in same-origin CSS
animationGrammar.assessment: Motion is light: the site relies on illustration and layout, not choreography.

navigation.mobile: logo + APPLY pill; menu items hidden

funnel.valueFirst: Newsletter (daily emails) and a gated X Playbook on a separate domain; the agency site sells directly with social proof first
funnel.socialProof: 'Trusted By 100+' logo strip, stat cluster (3,000,000+ followers, 10 Billion+ views, $15,000,000+ client sales, 15,000+ calls booked), 5 video case studies
funnel.claims: large unqualified numbers; 'results begin immediately, from Day one'; 'month-to-month'; 'from $5,000/month'
funnel.friction: low — one click to an external form

playbookUx.observed: Gate only: uppercase serif headline, one-line promise, email + 'Get Access' inline form, preview card of the playbook cover with a mascot.
playbookUx.reported: See ../notes/README.md — one major concept at a time, oversized headings, short text, physical analogy per concept, interactive reveals and card flips, sequential progression, CTA at the end.
